Nudie Jeans

- Unisex Crop/Taper model (MUD names vary by season) — pick the variant with stretch listed; try the hip-measured size, or one size up if no elastane. MUD emphasizes recycled/material circularity.

Everlane
- The Straight Crop / Mid-Rise Straight (cropped, mid-rise): start with a 31" waist equivalent; many styles include 1–2% elastane so they accommodate hips well. Price ~ $88–128. Transparent production and some sustainable denim lines.
- The Authentic Stretch High-Rise Slim/Straight (if you want higher rise + stretch): try the 31" and size up only if hips pull; price ~ $78–128.

Levi’s (widest range + easiest returns)
- Wedgie Straight Crop (mid/high-rise, cropped straight): try a 31–32"; good cropped/tapered look, price ~ $70–110. Some washes have slight stretch.
- 501 Crop (classic straight crop): try 31–32"; rigid or slight-stretch options, price ~ $70–110 — size up if no elastane.
- 512 / Taper (if you prefer a more tapered leg): try 31" and size up if hips are tight; price ~ $70–120.

Fit tips and returns
- Prioritize hip measurement for tapered/slim-straight cuts — pick the size that fits the widest point, then use minor tailoring at the waist/hem if needed.
- Look for 1–2% elastane in the fabric if you want forgiving hips. 
- Order two sizes where possible (31 and 32) if returns are easy — Levi’s and Everlane generally have straightforward return windows; Nudie offers repairs instead of returns in some cases, and MUD offers circular/rental options.
